audience: marketers and social media teams that shorten and track links with Bitly

useCases.title: Shorten a long link for a campaign
useCases.text: Shorten a long URL into a bitlink. Without force_new_link, Bitly returns the existing bitlink for the same URL.

useCases.title: Find the clicks of the best links
useCases.text: List the groups, then the bitlinks in one group. Read the click total of one bitlink over a window.

useCases.title: Count the scans of a QR code
useCases.text: Read one QR code with its destination. Then count its scans over a time window.

useCases.title: Check the plan limits of an organization
useCases.text: List the organizations, then read the plan limits and usage, such as API calls and short links.
